scope: Complete the supplied paleontology series in all eight languages, with targeted factual, editorial and framework-consistency corrections. Original source directory and ZIPs unchanged.

publication.afterword_presentation: Separate optional theoretical deep dive, not EP24; internal source/review key 24.

review.method: Read the four Simplified Chinese arguments; review correction sites, examples, headings and conclusions across editions. Targeted scientific and editorial review, not exhaustive independent verification of every assertion.
review.originals: 32 texts checked byte for byte against original Markdown files and ZIP members, with stored SHA-256.
corrections: EP21: a roughly 40% parasitism estimate does not imply most animals undergo reduction; free-living organisms are not wholly metabolically self-sufficient; distinguish relaxed selection, drift and possible savings. Scope pathway losses and Plasmodium FASII; introns are within genes. Avoid mandatory compensating gains and inferential overreach from null-model rejection. Plants dominate global biomass by carbon. Qualify frog teeth, reactivation times and dandelion reproduction. State analytical-error retraction accurately. Correct five-case tally to three rejected/two partial; a single-cell bottleneck reduces but does not eliminate conflict.

EP22: explicitly focus on nonhuman apes and selected fossil lineages, not all apes or all extant descendants. Distinguish taxon richness from abundance and scope bilophodont teeth to Old World monkeys. Repeated orthogrady depends on reconstructions. The 2024 Pliobates interpretation has conflicting anatomical analyses; do not present it as insensitive to evidence choice. Treat 2026 genus/species arithmetic as provisional; name Masripithecus. Limit African and island endpoints appropriately.

EP23: separate the formal boundary from the extinction horizon. Use the ICS GSSP-specific published threshold (>60% of voting membership: 13 of 20). Distinguish positions from formally named stages; correct Penglaitan ratification to 2004. Explain stratigraphic plutonium marker versus calendar event. Clarify stem membership and extinct crown members. Align reverse-transition tally; no transition does not mean no events. Replace the false unnamed-rock claim with named intervals not exhausting their history; qualify unmeasured reader responses.

Afterword: expressly identify DD as the author's philosophical interpretation, not a biological ranking or empirically proven stage sequence. Keep the seven-section discussion optional. Align 13DD self-subject and 14DD subject-as-own-end with Start Here; mortality reflection is not an eligibility test for subjecthood. Ancient cognition can be hard to preserve without being absent. Distinguish structural order from event order, thickness from calibrated time, historical irreversibility from chemistry, nearly universal code from exceptionless identity, and a minimal engineered cell from a universal minimum. Qualify division of labor, worker reproduction, reproductive costs, selection levels, color proxies and recovery gaps. Carry these corrections into the final synthesis.
All four: retain section and nonempty paragraph counts, replace repeated stock endings with episode-specific conclusions, leave original supplied texts immutable.
review.references: Primary papers, institutional research accounts, current ICS procedure/register, and site definitions linked in references.json.
review.completeness: Three essays retain eight sections each; afterword retains seven. All nonempty paragraph counts preserved. Minimum reviewed/original character ratio 0.9902. These checks supplement reading, not replace it.

verification.structural: scripts/test_paleontology.py: 5 tests passed for completeness, immutable sources, reproducibility, metadata, internal links, discovery, grouped contents and optional afterword.
verification.regression: EP01–19 byte-identical to pre-batch HEAD d4335f6; EP20 next-link only. Unrelated search records and prior update entries unchanged; existing publication dates and unchanged article sitemap dates retained.

verification.browser: 600 page/viewport cases at 375/768/1440 px passed: heading visibility, eight-language menus, TOC, no horizontal overflow. Library/Latest language switching and no-JS afterword switching passed; no page errors. After final date/reference/proofreading edits, another 96 new-page/viewport checks passed.
